# Overall Project Summary: August 2, 2026

Development on August 2 focused on hardening CI/CD infrastructure and improving agent runtime reliability, with significant progress made in stabilizing build pipelines and error handling. The team has also initiated a strategic shift toward repository modularization, with new requests to extract core components into standalone repositories.

## 🚨 Needs Attention 
- **[elizaos/eliza#13562](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/13562) Flawless testing loop**: Ongoing nightly failures in the "Views Soak" test require attention to achieve consistent green status across the device testing matrix.
- **[elizaos/eliza#17035](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17035) Connector discovery**: Requires end-to-end evidence (UI bubbles and external connector preservation) to move toward closure.
- **[elizaos/eliza#17120](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17120) Semantic OCR coverage**: A draft PR is currently awaiting maintainer approval for artifact releases to stabilize audited views.

## ✅ Completed Work

### CI/CD Pipeline Hardening
*   Improved reliability for app-build pipelines and fork-PR aggregate gates, ensuring held workflows are correctly identified ([elizaos/eliza#17479](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17479), [elizaos/eliza#17577](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17577)).
*   Protected GitHub Actions runner control directories from accidental pruning during workspace cleanup ([elizaos/eliza#17535](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17535), [elizaos/eliza#17575](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17575)).
*   Aligned fork build timeouts to accommodate cold build durations ([elizaos/eliza#17491](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17491)).

### Agent & Runtime Reliability
*   Refactored benchmark and boot processes to be owner-controlled, ensuring proper database and runtime shutdown ([elizaos/eliza#17531](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17531)).
*   Enhanced error handling for connector discovery to surface structured errors instead of relying on dashboard relays ([elizaos/eliza#17580](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17580)).
*   Added focused tests for smoke classification and gated plugin packages with dedicated unit tests ([elizaos/eliza#17553](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17553), [elizaos/eliza#17552](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17552)).

### Testing & Audit Coverage
*   Mandated semantic OCR coverage for audited views to improve UI testing accuracy ([elizaos/eliza#17581](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17581)).

## 🏗️ Work in Progress

### New Pull Requests (elizaos/eliza)
*   **Infrastructure & CI**: [#17593](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17593), [#17587](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17587), [#17585](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17585), [#17583](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17583), [#17578](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17578), [#17577](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17577).
*   **App & UI**: [#17592](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17592), [#17579](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17579), [#17576](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17576), [#17574](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17574), [#17572](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17572), [#17596](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17596).
*   **Core & Security**: [#17584](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17584), [#17573](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17573), [#17571](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17571), [#17570](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17570), [#17582](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17582).

### Active Discussions
*   **[elizaos/eliza#17114](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17114)**: Ongoing work addressing production blockers related to plugin imports and renderer routing.

## 🐞 Issue Triage

### New Issues (elizaos/eliza)
*   **Repository Extraction**: Requests to move Eliza Hub and eliza.army to standalone repositories ([#17568](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17568), [#17569](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17569)).
*   **Production & Documentation**: Reports of stuck production agents ([#17567](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17567)) and broken migration documentation ([#17590](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17590)).
*   **Hardware & Debugging**: Issues regarding LP3 debug builds and USB loopback ([#17586](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17586)).

### Closed Issues (elizaos/eliza)
*   Resolved issues regarding runner workspace pruning and CI assertion failures ([#17566](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17566), [#17588](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17588), [#17594](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17594)).
